Name: Grow Your Meat (Inspired by PPJA Fresh Meat)
Author: Wizadroid
Description:
As a spiritual successor to PPJA Fresh Meat this mod includes to bring growable meat back into the game. However unlike PPJA Fresh Meat it will not be directly growing the meat. Instead plants will be grown that can be turned into meat, akin to how soybeans can become tofu.

All seeds can currently be purchased at Pierre's during any season.
Current seeds include: Bovine Melon (Beef), Caprino Beans (Mutton), Hogifruit (Pork) and Poultryberry (Chicken). More will come in the future!

What can you currently do with these plants?

First they need to be processed in a new machine called an abattoir. It costs 1 battery pack, 5 iron and 3 oil. You unlock this at level 3 farming.
However! If you add certain oils along with your plant, you'll get higher quality products.
Bovine Melon > Abattoir > Raw Ground Beef
Bovine Melon + Oil > Abattoir > Raw Brisket
Bovine Melon + Bovine Melon Oil > Abattoir > Raw Steak
Bovine Melon + Truffle Oil > Abattoir > Raw Wagyu Steak - new with 1.1 update!

What's this bovine melon oil however? Another use for the plants! Simply throw one of the plant products into an oil maker to get their respective oils. Then use said oils with their respective plants in the abattoir to get the higher tier meats.

Alright you have your meat, now what?
Currently from here there are three options; Cook it, Smoke it, or Dry it. These are accomplished respectively at the Kiln, Fish Smoker, and Dehydrator.

Or process them in the three new machines added in 1.1, the Canning Machine, Sous Vide Machine, and Sausage Maker unlocked at levels 4, 6, and 8 farming respectively.

All meat products are counted as artisan goods and benefit from the artisan profession.

I'd also like to thank the lovely people of the stardew discord for their help and support. (and also to Selph for helping me learn to use their mod). ((And to Airyn for helping simplify the machine codes making it much easier to change in the future)).
